quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on Christian Anderson Jr.'s valuable bench production
quotes.excerpt: he's been doing great. Every single time he step on the court, he's been soaking in everything he can
quotes.quote: He's young, but he's been doing great. Every single time he step on the court, he's been soaking in everything he can and trying to apply it as fast as he can as well. Obviously he can shoot, we all know that, and for him it's just to go on, keep on gaining confidence. He's been doing that since the beginning of the season, practices, listening to the vets. quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on Stan Box's G League transition and performance
quotes.excerpt: it's very hard when you're young and you're not playing much. I remember being that position as well
quotes.quote: It was good. Like I said, it's very hard when you're young and you're not playing much. I remember being that position as well. So, yeah, like I said, he's been doing great in the G League. Obviously he's probably the best player in the G right now. I mean, I haven't really watched the games, but from what I've seen at least, he's been doing great and yeah, I mean he's only going to keep on getting better and getting adjusted.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on building chemistry with shifting lineups
quotes.excerpt: nobody's going to come save us. I think that we do a great job at working on what we have right now
quotes.quote: That's all we got. At the end of the day, there's only so much you can say, right? I think that at the end of the day, that's all we got. Nobody's going to come save us. I think that we do a great job at working on what we have right now. Obviously we're missing some guys, but still not an excuse, no matter what. I will never come in and be like, oh yeah, this is the reason why we lost. I think we have plenty, we have enough.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate on the Hornets roster: Nobody is going to come save us. We have plenty, we have enough. I will never come in and say missing guys is the reason why we lost.

structured.context: Moussa Diabate addresses the team's ability to compete despite missing players and shifting lineups.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on the team's mindset during a losing streak
quotes.excerpt: even in the losses and the struggle, there's also progression. I think that's the best way to put it

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Charles just came in here and said that you guys were so close to a serious breakthrough. You just said that no one's going to come and save you guys. You think you have a good enough team to win these games.

text_blocks.speaker: Moussa Diabate
text_blocks.text: What's the pulse like in that locker room after, you know, these constant losses? What's everyone's mindset in there? I mean, for sure not happy, right? Nobody's looking at it like, yeah, this is a good thing that we're losing, right? But at the same time, there's an understanding that even in the losses and the struggle, there's also progression. I think that's the best way to put it. You don't want to be too low, you don't want to be too high.

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate on the locker room mindset: Nobody is looking at it like this is a good thing that we are losing. But at the same time there is an understanding that even in the losses and the struggle there is also progression.

structured.context: Moussa Diabate describes the locker room mindset and the team's focus on progression despite a losing streak.
